rounds.text: I Power Solutions India Ltd trades at a price-to-book ratio of 1.88x compared to a much steeper sector benchmark of 7.35x, demonstrating significant relative asset undervaluation [E6]. The company benefits from strong sector tailwinds, backed by a sector median sales growth of 17.6% and a sector median profit growth of 12.2% [E58, E59]. Furthermore, the screen engine identifies that earnings growth is accelerating [E51]. Long-term shareholders have been rewarded with consistent compounded share price growth of 27% over 3 years, 35% over 5 years, and 18% over 10 years [E15, E16, E17]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months sits at -89%, and return on equity is -22.56% against the sector benchmark of 10.06% [E8, E13].
